Which statement about nitrogen molecules and ethene molecules is correct?
A
A nitrogen molecule has 2 more shared electrons than an ethene molecule.
B
An ethene molecule has 3 more shared electrons than a nitrogen molecule.
C
A nitrogen molecule has 4 more shared electrons than an ethene molecule.
D
An ethene molecule has 6 more shared electrons than a nitrogen molecule.
